_note: Phase 2 features that can be switched on and off in the prototype. 'default' is what everyone sees until they change it on the Prototype settings page or with ?features= in a link. Add an entry when a feature is built; remove it once the feature is in the real service and the prototype has been re-synced. A feature can list others in 'requires': it is on only when they are on too, and switching it on switches them on.

features.name: Admin dashboard
features.description: A read-only view for the Marketplace Team of every registered user, application and production credentials request, on the Admin page that admins already see.

features.name: Production requests for each API
features.description: A production credentials request covers the APIs you choose, and each API gets its own outcome, because the Data Access Team review each API in an application. You can ask for more of an application's APIs later, with your earlier answers filled in.

features.name: Get production credentials yourself
features.description: Once the Data Access Team approve a production request, the Marketplace Team record the decision on the Admin pages. The requester is emailed, signs in and generates their own production credentials, with the client secret shown once.
